app.title: Relax: JIT compiler for Rust to reduce build times
app.description: A Just-In-Time compiler that integrates with Rust to accelerate compilation times by caching and reusing compiled artifacts.
proposed_tests: Install the relax binary via cargo install
Compile a medium-sized Rust project with and without relax and compare compile times
Run cargo run on a sample binary and ensure output correctness
Verify that the build cache is reused on a second compilation run
